definitions.explanation: The lower portion or bottom area of something. Used in descriptions, instructions, and technical contexts to indicate the part that is lower in position.

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}の{下部|かぶ}にボタンがある。
examples.english: There is a button at the bottom of the screen.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}の{下部|かぶ}に{汚|よご}れがついていた。
examples.english: There were stains on the lower part of the wall.

examples.japanese: その{橋|はし}の{下部|かぶ}は{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}が{進|すす}んでいるため、{補修|ほしゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The lower part of that bridge is deteriorating, so repairs are needed.

notes:
{下部|かぶ} refers to the lower portion of an object, structure, or space. Somewhat formal; common in written, technical, and descriptive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下部|かぶ}に{位置|いち}する: to be located in the lower part
- ページの{下部|かぶ}: the bottom of the page
- {車体|しゃたい}の{下部|かぶ}: the underside of a vehicle
- {画面|がめん}の{下部|かぶ}: the bottom of the screen

PAIR:
Opposite is {上部|じょうぶ} (upper part).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {底|そこ}: bottom (the very lowest point)
- {下|した}: below, under (everyday word, broader usage)
- {末端|まったん}: end, tip (the furthest extremity)
